verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a Dashboard review queue for flagged or unusual payments, including targeted review lists built from criteria you specify. Risk insights shows the risk factors (signals) behind each Radar decision, and a network view of related payments links other payments sharing the same customer ID, IP address or card number, covering customer history and related cases. The Reviews API supports actions such as approve. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow, true similarity-based 'similar cases' beyond shared identifiers, and explicit tooling for consistent decisions such as reviewer guidance or playbooks.
